'''Tobias DaVoren''' is a boy from [[Aturo's Orchard]].
== History ==
Tobias is the son of [[Fenton DaVoren|Fenton]] and [[Annabelle DaVoren]], a farmer family from the small town of Aturo's Orchard.

The town is attacked by [[Whitecloaks]], and the farm is left in ruin.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
